preamble: This specification captures bootstrap and HTTP surface behaviour inferred from the bound Python behaviour source for shopapi: configuration loading, application lifespan, middleware, domain exception mapping, router mounting, authentication wiring, and the uvicorn serve entrypoint.
Requirements below are ordered by engine id; scenarios express triggers and observable outcomes drawn from requirement statements and evidenced criteria where present.

requirements.subject: start.settings-load
body: Bootstrap instantiates Settings so configuration is read from environment variables with prefix SHOPAPI_ and from the .env file.

scenarios.name: Bootstrap loads configuration
scenarios.when: The application bootstrap instantiates Settings
scenarios.then: Configuration is read from environment variables with prefix SHOPAPI_ and from the .env file
and: Settings uses env_prefix SHOPAPI_ and env_file .env

requirements.subject: start.shipping-client-construct
body: Bootstrap constructs the orders module ShippingClient with an httpx AsyncClient using settings.shipping_api_url, settings.request_timeout_s, and a Bearer token from settings.shipping_api_key.

scenarios.name: Shipping client uses configured HTTP settings
scenarios.when: Bootstrap constructs the orders module ShippingClient with an httpx AsyncClient
scenarios.then: The client uses settings.shipping_api_url, settings.request_timeout_s, and a Bearer token from settings.shipping_api_key
and: The shipping API base URL defaults to https://rates.courier.example/v2 when unset
The shipping HTTP client timeout defaults to 5.0 seconds when unset
The shipping API key defaults to an empty string when unset

requirements.subject: start.lifespan-logging
body: Before serving, the lifespan configures logging at the level from settings.log_level.

scenarios.name: Lifespan configures logging before serve
scenarios.when: The lifespan context runs before the server accepts traffic
scenarios.then: Logging is configured at the level from settings.log_level
and: The log level defaults to info when unset

requirements.subject: start.lifespan-cache-connect
body: Before serving, the lifespan connects the shared cache to Redis.

scenarios.name: Lifespan connects cache to Redis
scenarios.when: The lifespan runs cache connect before serving
scenarios.then: The shared cache is connected to Redis
and: The Redis URL defaults to redis://localhost:6379/0 when unset

requirements.subject: start.lifespan-cache-connect.ping
body: Cache connect creates a Redis client from settings.redis_url with decode_responses True and pings Redis.

scenarios.name: Cache connect builds client and pings Redis
scenarios.when: Cache connect runs during lifespan startup
scenarios.then: [unknown]
and: A Redis client is created from settings.redis_url with decode_responses True and Redis is pinged

requirements.subject: start.lifespan-ready-log
body: After cache connect, the lifespan logs that shopapi is ready on settings.port.

scenarios.name: Readiness log after cache connect
scenarios.when: Cache connect completes during lifespan startup
scenarios.then: An info log reports that shopapi is ready on settings.port
and: The listen port defaults to 8000 when unset

requirements.subject: start.lifespan-shutdown-shipping
body: On shutdown, the lifespan closes the orders module shipping HTTP client.

scenarios.name: Shutdown closes shipping HTTP client
scenarios.when: The application lifespan shuts down
scenarios.then: The orders module shipping HTTP client is closed

requirements.subject: start.lifespan-shutdown-cache
body: On shutdown, the lifespan closes the shared cache connection.

scenarios.name: Shutdown closes shared cache
scenarios.when: The application lifespan shuts down
scenarios.then: The shared cache connection is closed

requirements.subject: start.lifespan-shutdown-cache.close
body: Cache close acloses the Redis client when one is open and clears the client reference.

scenarios.name: Cache close releases Redis client
scenarios.when: Cache close runs on shutdown with an open Redis client
scenarios.then: The Redis client is aclosed and the client reference is cleared

requirements.subject: start.fastapi-app
body: Bootstrap builds a FastAPI application titled shopapi at version 1.2.0 with the lifespan context manager.

scenarios.name: FastAPI app metadata and lifespan
scenarios.when: Bootstrap builds the FastAPI application
scenarios.then: The app is titled shopapi at version 1.2.0 and uses the lifespan context manager
and: The application title is shopapi and the version is 1.2.0

requirements.subject: start.cors-middleware
body: Bootstrap applies CORSMiddleware allowing settings.cors_origins, methods GET POST and PUT, and headers authorization and content-type on every request.

scenarios.name: CORS applied on every request
scenarios.when: Any HTTP request is handled by the application
scenarios.then: CORSMiddleware allows settings.cors_origins with methods GET, POST, and PUT and headers authorization and content-type

requirements.subject: start.server-timing-middleware
body: Every HTTP response includes a server-timing header reporting app duration in milliseconds.

scenarios.name: Responses include server timing
scenarios.when: The application returns an HTTP response
scenarios.then: The response includes a server-timing header reporting app duration in milliseconds

requirements.subject: start.exception-not-found
body: A NotFoundError raised during a request returns 404 with error not_found and the exception detail.

scenarios.name: NotFoundError maps to 404
scenarios.when: A handler raises NotFoundError during a request
scenarios.then: The response is 404 with error not_found and the exception detail

requirements.subject: start.exception-conflict
body: A ConflictError raised during a request returns 409 with error conflict, the conflict state, and the exception detail.

scenarios.name: ConflictError maps to 409
scenarios.when: A handler raises ConflictError during a request
scenarios.then: The response is 409 with error conflict, the conflict state, and the exception detail

requirements.subject: start.exception-validation
body: A ValidationError raised during a request returns 422 with error validation, the field name, and the exception detail.

scenarios.name: ValidationError maps to 422
scenarios.when: A handler raises ValidationError during a request
scenarios.then: The response is 422 with error validation, the field name, and the exception detail

requirements.subject: start.exception-upstream
body: An UpstreamError raised during a request is logged as an upstream failure and returns 502 with error upstream, the system name, and the exception detail.

scenarios.name: UpstreamError maps to 502
scenarios.when: A handler raises UpstreamError during a request
scenarios.then: The response is 502 with error upstream, the system name, and the exception detail
and: The failure is logged as an upstream failure

requirements.subject: start.include-health-router
body: Bootstrap mounts the health router at its /health prefix without an API version prefix.

scenarios.name: Health router mounted without API version
scenarios.when: Bootstrap registers routers on the FastAPI app
scenarios.then: The health router is mounted at /health without an /api/v1 prefix

requirements.subject: start.include-orders-router
body: Bootstrap mounts the orders router under the /api/v1 prefix.

scenarios.name: Orders router under API v1
scenarios.when: Bootstrap registers API routers
scenarios.then: The orders router is mounted under the /api/v1 prefix at /orders

requirements.subject: start.orders-router-authed
body: The orders router is registered with the Authed dependency on every route.

scenarios.name: Orders routes require Authed
scenarios.when: An orders router route is registered
scenarios.then: The route is registered with the Authed dependency on every route

requirements.subject: start.include-customers-router
body: Bootstrap mounts the customers router under the /api/v1 prefix.

scenarios.name: Customers router under API v1
scenarios.when: Bootstrap registers API routers
scenarios.then: The customers router is mounted under the /api/v1 prefix at /customers

requirements.subject: start.customers-router-authed
body: The customers router is registered with the Authed dependency on every route.

scenarios.name: Customers routes require Authed
scenarios.when: A customers router route is registered
scenarios.then: The route is registered with the Authed dependency on every route

requirements.subject: start.serve-uvicorn
body: The serve entrypoint runs uvicorn on app.main:app at host 0.0.0.0 on settings.port with log level settings.log_level.

scenarios.name: Serve entrypoint runs uvicorn
scenarios.when: The serve entrypoint is invoked
scenarios.then: Uvicorn runs app.main:app at host 0.0.0.0 on settings.port with log level settings.log_level

losers.statement: Customers routes reject a request whose bearer token is missing or not listed in settings.api_tokens with a 401 response and detail missing or unknown bearer token.
Every orders route rejects a request whose bearer token is missing or not listed in settings.api_tokens with a 401 response.

scenarios.name: Bearer token missing or not configured
given: The request targets a customers route protected by Authed
scenarios.when: No Authorization bearer is sent, or the bearer value is absent from settings.api_tokens
scenarios.then: Whether rejection is a 401 alone or a 401 that includes a detail of missing or unknown bearer token must be decided for customers versus orders routes

requirements.subject: customers.post
body: POST /customers accepts a CustomerIn body, registers the customer through CustomerService, returns 201 with a CustomerOut body, and sets the Location header to /api/v1/customers/{id}.

scenarios.name: Register new customer
scenarios.when: Client POSTs /customers with a body that passes CustomerIn validation
scenarios.then: The handler registers via CustomerService and the API responds with 201, a CustomerOut body, and Location /api/v1/customers/{id}

requirements.subject: customers.post.body-validation
body: Registration requires a valid EmailStr email, a name, and an optional tier before the handler runs.

scenarios.name: Name length bounds
scenarios.when: The registration body has a name shorter than 1 character or longer than 120 characters
scenarios.then: Validation fails before the register handler runs

scenarios.name: Tier omitted on register
scenarios.when: The registration body omits tier
scenarios.then: The request is treated as tier standard before the handler runs

requirements.subject: customers.post.normalize-email
body: Registration compares and persists the email in lowercase.

scenarios.name: Mixed-case email on register
scenarios.when: Client POSTs a new customer whose email contains uppercase letters
scenarios.then: The created customer's email field matches the submitted address with every letter lowercased

requirements.subject: customers.post.reject-duplicate-email
body: Registration raises ConflictError with state registered when the lowercase email is already stored.

scenarios.name: Email already registered
given: A customer row already exists for the lowercase form of the submitted email
scenarios.when: Client POSTs registration with that email
scenarios.then: Registration raises ConflictError with state registered

requirements.subject: customers.post.create-customer
body: Registration assigns a new string uuid id, the request name and tier, and created_at from datetime.now(UTC) before insert.

scenarios.name: Fields assigned before insert
scenarios.when: Registration accepts a new unique email
scenarios.then: The new customer receives a string uuid id, the request name and tier, and created_at from datetime.now(UTC) before insert

requirements.subject: customers.post.persist
body: Registration adds the new customer through CustomerRepository.insert before returning it.

scenarios.name: Insert before response
scenarios.when: Registration builds a new customer entity
scenarios.then: CustomerRepository.insert adds the customer before the handler returns it

requirements.subject: customers.post.audit-log
body: Registration emits an info log naming the new customer id and tier.

scenarios.name: Info log on register
scenarios.when: A customer is successfully inserted
scenarios.then: An info log names the new customer id and tier

requirements.subject: customers.post.response-mapping
body: Customer responses expose id, email, name, tier, and created_at as an ISO 8601 string from the stored customer.

scenarios.name: CustomerOut shape
scenarios.when: A customer is returned from register or get
scenarios.then: The response exposes id, email, name, tier, and created_at as an ISO 8601 string from the stored customer

requirements.subject: customers.get-customer-id
body: GET /customers/{customer_id} loads the customer through CustomerService.get and returns CustomerOut.

scenarios.name: Load by id
scenarios.when: Client GETs /customers/{customer_id}
scenarios.then: CustomerService.get loads the customer and the API returns CustomerOut

requirements.subject: customers.get-customer-id.cache-hit
body: Get returns a Customer rebuilt from the cache entry when cache.get for customer:{customer_id} is not None.

scenarios.name: Redis entry present
given: cache.get for customer:{customer_id} returns a non-None payload
scenarios.when: Client GETs that customer_id
scenarios.then: The handler returns a Customer rebuilt from the cache entry without requiring a repository miss path

requirements.subject: customers.get-customer-id.not-found
body: Get raises NotFoundError for kind customer when the repository find returns None.

scenarios.name: Unknown customer id
given: CustomerRepository.find returns None for the id
scenarios.when: Client GETs /customers/{customer_id}
scenarios.then: CustomerService.get raises NotFoundError for kind customer

requirements.subject: customers.get-customer-id.cache-store
body: Get stores a dumped customer dict under customer:{customer_id} with TTL settings.cache_ttl_s after a repository hit.

scenarios.name: Populate cache after repository hit
given: Cache miss and repository returns a customer
scenarios.when: Get completes for that customer_id
scenarios.then: A dumped customer dict is stored under customer:{customer_id} with TTL settings.cache_ttl_s

scenarios.name: Default cache TTL
scenarios.when: Get stores a customer in cache after a repository hit
scenarios.then: The entry TTL is 300 seconds

requirements.subject: customers.get-customer-id.cache-disabled
body: Get treats a disconnected cache as a miss because cache.get returns None when Cache.client is None.

scenarios.name: Redis disconnected
scenarios.when: Get invokes cache.get for customer:{customer_id}
scenarios.then: cache.get returns None and get treats the request as a cache miss

requirements.subject: customers.get-customer-id.cache-payload
body: Cached customer payloads include id, email, name, tier, and created_at from the Customer instance.

scenarios.name: Cached customer fields
scenarios.when: Get writes a customer to cache after a repository hit
scenarios.then: The cached payload includes id, email, name, tier, and created_at from the Customer instance

requirements.subject: customers.post-customer-id-tier-tier
body: POST /customers/{customer_id}/tier/{tier} promotes the customer through CustomerService.promote and returns CustomerOut.

scenarios.name: Promote tier
scenarios.when: Client POSTs /customers/{customer_id}/tier/{tier} with arguments accepted by promote
scenarios.then: CustomerService.promote runs and the API returns CustomerOut

requirements.subject: customers.post-customer-id-tier-tier.reject-unknown-tier
body: Promote raises ConflictError with the requested tier as state when tier is not in TIERS.

scenarios.name: Tier not in catalogue
scenarios.when: The path tier is outside standard, silver, and gold
scenarios.then: Promote raises ConflictError with the requested tier as state

requirements.subject: customers.post-customer-id-tier-tier.reject-no-upgrade
body: Promote raises ConflictError with the customer's current tier as state when TIERS.index(tier) is not greater than TIERS.index(customer.tier).

scenarios.name: Non-increasing tier rank
given: The customer's current tier rank is not lower than the requested tier
scenarios.when: Client POSTs promote for that tier
scenarios.then: Promote raises ConflictError with the customer's current tier as state

requirements.subject: customers.post-customer-id-tier-tier.apply-tier
body: Promote sets customer.tier to the requested tier, persists through CustomerRepository.insert, invalidates cache key customer:{customer_id}, and returns the customer.

scenarios.name: Successful promotion
scenarios.when: Promote accepts the requested tier
scenarios.then: customer.tier is set to the requested tier, CustomerRepository.insert persists the row, cache key customer:{customer_id} is invalidated, and the updated customer is returned

requirements.subject: customers.db-session-commit
body: A customers handler that completes without error commits the SQLAlchemy session before the response is returned.

scenarios.name: Successful customers request
scenarios.when: A customers route handler finishes without raising
scenarios.then: The SQLAlchemy session is committed before the HTTP response is returned

requirements.subject: customers.db-session-rollback
body: A customers handler that raises rolls back the SQLAlchemy session and re-raises the exception.

scenarios.name: Handler error
scenarios.when: A customers route handler raises before completing
scenarios.then: The SQLAlchemy session is rolled back and the same exception is re-raised

requirements.subject: health.get.dependency-checks
body: Liveness includes a database check and a cache check keyed as database and cache in the checks object.

scenarios.name: Liveness response includes dependency keys
scenarios.when: GET /health is invoked
scenarios.then: the response body includes a checks object with database and cache entries

requirements.subject: health.get.sets-503-when-degraded
body: Liveness sets the response status to 503 when any dependency check is false.

scenarios.name: Degraded liveness uses 503
scenarios.when: liveness runs with at least one dependency check evaluating false
scenarios.then: the HTTP response status is 503

requirements.subject: health.get.status-body
body: Liveness returns status ok when every check is true and status degraded otherwise, with the checks map in the body.

scenarios.name: All dependencies healthy
scenarios.when: GET /health runs and every dependency check is true
scenarios.then: the response body has status ok and includes the checks map

scenarios.name: Any dependency unhealthy
scenarios.when: GET /health runs and at least one dependency check is false
scenarios.then: the response body has status degraded and includes the checks map

requirements.subject: health.get.database-check
body: The database dependency check opens a connection on the shared engine and runs select 1.

scenarios.name: Database probe mechanism
scenarios.when: the liveness handler performs the database dependency check
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: health.get.database-check-failure
body: The database dependency check reports false when any exception occurs during connect or execute.

scenarios.name: Database connect or query error
scenarios.when: connecting on the shared engine or executing the database probe raises an exception
scenarios.then: the database entry in checks is false

requirements.subject: health.get.cache-unconnected
body: The cache dependency check reports false when cache.client is None.

scenarios.name: Cache client absent
scenarios.when: cache.client is None during the liveness cache check
scenarios.then: the cache entry in checks is false

requirements.subject: health.get.cache-ping
body: The cache dependency check reports the boolean result of await cache.client.ping() when a client is present.

scenarios.name: Cache client present
scenarios.when: cache.client is set and the liveness cache check runs
scenarios.then: the cache entry in checks matches the boolean result of await cache.client.ping()

requirements.subject: health.get.cache-check-failure
body: The cache dependency check reports false when ping raises any exception.

scenarios.name: Cache ping error
scenarios.when: await cache.client.ping() raises an exception during the liveness cache check
scenarios.then: the cache entry in checks is false

requirements.subject: health.get-ready.returns-ready
body: Readiness always returns ready true with no dependency probes.

scenarios.name: Readiness without probes
scenarios.when: GET /health/ready is invoked
scenarios.then: the response body is ready true and no dependency probes are run

requirements.subject: orders.get.lists-orders-page
body: List orders returns a page of orders with optional filters for customer_id and state, plus page and size echoing the request.

scenarios.name: List orders with query parameters
scenarios.when: An authenticated client sends GET to list orders with optional customer_id, state, page, and size query parameters
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.get.pagination-bounds
body: List orders accepts page at least 1 and size between 1 and settings.max_page_size inclusive, defaulting size to settings.default_page_size.

scenarios.name: Default list page size
scenarios.when: An authenticated client lists orders without a size query parameter
scenarios.then: The effective page size is settings.default_page_size (20 when unset)

scenarios.name: Maximum list page size cap
scenarios.when: An authenticated client lists orders with size equal to settings.max_page_size
scenarios.then: The request is accepted with size at most settings.max_page_size (100 when unset)

requirements.subject: orders.get.filters-by-customer-and-state
body: List orders restricts results to the given customer_id and/or state when those query parameters are provided and orders by created_at descending before offset and limit.

scenarios.name: Filter list by customer and state
scenarios.when: An authenticated client lists orders providing customer_id and/or state query parameters
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post.rejects-duplicate-skus
body: Place order rejects a body whose lines repeat the same sku with a validation error stating each sku appears once.

scenarios.name: Duplicate SKU in order lines
scenarios.when: A client posts a place-order body whose lines include the same sku more than once
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post.validates-line-and-address-fields
body: Place order validates each line sku, quantity, and ship-to address fields through PlaceOrder and LineIn before the handler runs.

scenarios.name: Line count within bounds
scenarios.when: A client posts a place-order body with a number of lines outside 1 through MAX_LINES inclusive
scenarios.then: Validation fails before the place-order handler runs

scenarios.name: Line SKU format
scenarios.when: A client posts a place-order line whose sku is not 1–32 characters matching ^[A-Z0-9-]+$
scenarios.then: Validation fails before the place-order handler runs

scenarios.name: Line quantity bounds
scenarios.when: A client posts a place-order line whose quantity is outside 1 through MAX_QUANTITY inclusive
scenarios.then: Validation fails before the place-order handler runs

scenarios.name: Ship-to postcode format
scenarios.when: A client posts a place-order body whose ship_to postcode does not match ^\d{4}$
scenarios.then: Validation fails before the place-order handler runs

requirements.subject: orders.post.creates-pending-order
body: Place order loads the customer, prices lines, quotes shipping, persists a new order in pending state with priced lines and computed totals, and returns the created order.

scenarios.name: Successful placement persists pending order
scenarios.when: A client posts a valid place-order request for an existing customer with catalogue SKUs and sufficient stock
scenarios.then: The handler returns the created order

requirements.subject: orders.post.responds-201-with-location
body: Place order responds with 201 and sets the Location header to /api/v1/orders/{order.id}.

scenarios.name: Created order response headers
scenarios.when: Place order completes successfully and persists the new order
scenarios.then: The HTTP response status is 201

scenarios.name: Location header for new order
scenarios.when: Place order completes successfully and persists the new order
scenarios.then: The Location header is /api/v1/orders/{order.id}
and: The new order id is the one assigned at placement

requirements.subject: orders.post.rejects-unknown-customer
body: Place order fails when the customer_id does not exist.

scenarios.name: Non-existent customer_id
scenarios.when: A client posts place order with a customer_id that does not exist
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post.rejects-unknown-sku
body: Place order rejects a line whose sku is not in the catalogue.

scenarios.name: SKU absent from catalogue
scenarios.when: A client posts place order including a line sku not present in the catalogue
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post.rejects-insufficient-stock
body: Place order rejects a line whose quantity exceeds the product stock on hand.

scenarios.name: Quantity above stock on hand
scenarios.when: A client posts place order with a line quantity greater than the product stock on hand
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post.quotes-cheapest-shipping-rate
body: Place order obtains a shipping quote by resolving the ship-to postcode to a zone, calling the rates API, and selecting the lowest price_cents quote.

scenarios.name: Lowest priced shipping quote selected
scenarios.when: Place order resolves the ship-to postcode to a zone and the rates API returns multiple quotes
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post.rejects-postcode-outside-zones
body: Place order fails when the ship-to postcode is not digits or matches no delivery zone.

scenarios.name: Postcode not mappable to a zone
scenarios.when: A client posts place order whose ship_to postcode is not digits or matches no delivery zone
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post.rates-api-retries
body: Shipping rate fetches retry up to MAX_ATTEMPTS on transport errors or 5xx responses, sleeping RETRY_BACKOFF_S times the attempt between tries, and fail on 4xx or exhausted retries.

scenarios.name: Retry limit on rate fetch
scenarios.when: Shipping rate GET encounters transport errors or 5xx responses on successive attempts
scenarios.then: At most MAX_ATTEMPTS fetch attempts are made (3)

scenarios.name: Backoff between rate fetch retries
scenarios.when: A shipping rate fetch fails with a retriable error before the final attempt
scenarios.then: The wait before the next attempt is RETRY_BACKOFF_S seconds multiplied by the attempt number (0.25 seconds per attempt step)

requirements.subject: orders.post.applies-tier-and-bulk-discount
body: Place order discount_cents applies the customer tier discount in basis points and raises it to the bulk discount when total line quantity reaches BULK_UNITS.

scenarios.name: Tier and bulk discount on discount_cents
scenarios.when: Place order prices lines for a customer whose tier defines a discount and line quantities may reach bulk threshold
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post.waives-shipping-at-threshold
body: Place order sets shipping_cents to 0 when subtotal after discount is at least FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD_CENTS.

scenarios.name: Free shipping when subtotal after discount qualifies
scenarios.when: Place order computes subtotal after discount at or above FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD_CENTS
scenarios.then: shipping_cents is 0

requirements.subject: orders.post.adds-rural-surcharge
body: Place order adds RURAL_SURCHARGE_CENTS to quoted shipping when the postcode zone is rural and free shipping does not apply.

scenarios.name: Rural surcharge amount
scenarios.when: Quoted shipping applies to a rural postcode zone and free shipping does not apply
scenarios.then: RURAL_SURCHARGE_CENTS (650) is added to quoted shipping

requirements.subject: orders.post.totals-sum-parts
body: Place order total_cents equals subtotal_cents minus discount_cents plus shipping_cents.

scenarios.name: Order total from components
scenarios.when: Place order has computed subtotal_cents, discount_cents, and shipping_cents
scenarios.then: total_cents equals subtotal_cents minus discount_cents plus shipping_cents

requirements.subject: orders.get-order-id.returns-cached-order
body: Get order returns the order deserialized from cache when key order:{order_id} is present.

scenarios.name: Cache hit for order key
scenarios.when: An authenticated client requests an order by id while cache key order:{order_id} is present
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.get-order-id.loads-and-caches-miss
body: Get order loads the order from the store on cache miss, stores it under order:{order_id} for settings.order_cache_ttl_s seconds, and returns it.

scenarios.name: Cache TTL after load on miss
scenarios.when: An authenticated client requests an order by id and cache key order:{order_id} is absent
scenarios.then: The loaded order is stored under order:{order_id} for settings.order_cache_ttl_s seconds (60 when unset)

requirements.subject: orders.get-order-id.not-found
body: Get order fails when no order exists for the given order_id.

scenarios.name: Missing order id
scenarios.when: An authenticated client requests an order id that does not exist in the store
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.put-order-id-lines.amends-pending-only
body: Amend lines rejects an order whose state is not pending.

scenarios.name: Amend on non-pending order
scenarios.when: A client amends lines on an order whose state is not pending
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.put-order-id-lines.replaces-lines-and-totals
body: Amend lines reprices the request lines, requotes shipping, replaces order lines and monetary fields, updates the order, invalidates order cache, and returns the order.

scenarios.name: Successful line amendment
scenarios.when: A client amends lines on a pending order with valid replacement lines
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.put-order-id-lines.validates-lines
body: Amend lines validates replacement lines through AmendLines before the handler runs.

scenarios.name: Amend line count within bounds
scenarios.when: A client sends amend-lines with a number of replacement lines outside 1 through MAX_LINES inclusive
scenarios.then: Validation fails before the amend-lines handler runs

requirements.subject: orders.put-order-id-lines.rates-api-retries
body: Amend lines uses the same shipping rate fetch retry and error rules as place order when requoting.

scenarios.name: Requote uses place-order retry rules
scenarios.when: Amend lines requotes shipping and the rates API returns retriable transport or 5xx errors
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post-order-id-transitions.rejects-terminal
body: Transition rejects an order already in a terminal state delivered or cancelled.

scenarios.name: Transition from terminal state
scenarios.when: A client requests a state transition on an order already in delivered or cancelled
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post-order-id-transitions.rejects-invalid-target
body: Transition rejects a requested state not listed in TRANSITIONS for the order current state, including pending to shipped.

scenarios.name: Disallowed target state for current state
given: An order exists in pending state
scenarios.when: The client POSTs a transition requesting state shipped
scenarios.then: [unknown]

scenarios.name: Target not in TRANSITIONS map
given: An order exists in a non-terminal state
scenarios.when: The client POSTs a transition to a state that TRANSITIONS does not allow from the order's current state
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post-order-id-transitions.cancel-requires-reason
body: Transition to cancelled requires a non-empty reason.

scenarios.name: Cancel without a reason
given: An order exists that may transition to cancelled
scenarios.when: The client POSTs a transition to cancelled with no reason field
scenarios.then: [unknown]

scenarios.name: Cancel with empty reason
given: An order exists that may transition to cancelled
scenarios.when: The client POSTs a transition to cancelled with a blank reason
scenarios.then: [unknown]

requirements.subject: orders.post-order-id-transitions.records-transition
body: Transition sets the new state, appends a transition record with timestamp and reason, persists the order, invalidates cache, and returns the order.

scenarios.name: Successful state change
given: An order in a non-terminal state and a valid transition target
scenarios.when: The client POSTs an allowed transition with any required fields supplied
scenarios.then: The response carries the order with state updated to the requested value
and: The order's transition history includes a new entry with a timestamp and the supplied reason when provided
The order row is updated in the store
The cached entry for that order id is removed
